$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file against

departments.description: The departments tickets are filed under, each a department:<name> label

steps.description: The version each step runs at. A step left out runs at its oldest live version, or not at all when it is opt-in, such as plan

anyOf.description: The step version to run, e.g. 2 for review@2

local.description: Path to the project's own step, from the project root

anyOf.description: A local step: the project supplies this step itself

paperTrail.description: Where the File step writes timesheets, memos and sign-offs, and grade@1 its grades

anyOf.description: This project keeps no paper trail

repo.description: owner/name of the repository the File step writes to

timesheet.description: Path of the timesheet: one JSON line per shift, its table in README.md beside it

signOffs.description: Folder for sign-offs: one JSON file each, in a folder per day

memoLabel.description: Label on each memo, an issue in the repository per machine per day

suggestionBox.description: Folder for the suggestion box: each shift's notes in a folder per day, and reviews.jsonl, one line per performance review

grades.description: Folder for grades: one JSON file per merged ticket and per graded shift, in a folder per day

shiftSampleRate.description: Share of shifts the grader grades, from 0 to 1, unless grades steer it: every shift while one of the last 5 graded failed, 0.1 after 10 passes in a row

securityReviews.description: Path of the security reviews: one JSON line per weekly security review of main

labelRenames.description: Old label names this project renames to factory labels, beyond the factory's own list, e.g. { factory: "kind:tooling" }

modules.description: Optional capabilities the project switches on

translations.description: The copy desk settles the final English and every translation

anyOf.description: This project doesn't use the module

source.description: The locale the copy desk writes first

locales.description: Every other locale the copy desk translates into, e.g. he, ar, ru, fr

catalog.description: Path of one locale's message catalog, with {locale} where the locale goes, from the project root

copyRules.description: The project's copy rules, which the English is rewritten to, from the project root

glossary.description: The term list every locale must use, from the project root

changed.description: Lists the catalog keys a branch added or changed, with the base ref appended

checks.description: Commands the copy desk runs before each commit, all of which must pass

items.description: A check the catalogs must pass

screenshots.description: Changed screens are shot and judged by the looks inspector

anyOf.description: This project doesn't use the module

command.description: Takes screenshots of the changed screens into the folder in $SHOTS_DIR

locales.description: The locales each screen is shot in; add a right-to-left one if the project has one

references.description: The doc naming the reference screens a new screen must look like; a ticket may name its own, from the project root

mobile.description: Device checks on one simulator, and native changes left for a person

anyOf.description: This project doesn't use the module

department.description: The department of tickets built on the machine with the simulator

app.description: The mobile app's folder, whose package.json dependencies are native, from the project root

native.description: Globs, from the project root, of files whose change needs a new dev build, e.g. apps/mobile/ios/**

harness.description: Globs, from the project root, of files that only drive the flows, e.g. the device scripts and e2e config; a change to these alone reaches no flow

startDevice.description: Starts a device check on this machine's simulator, on the dev build installed there

buildDevice.description: Builds and installs this checkout's dev build on the simulator, then starts a device check on it; without it only a person makes dev builds, and startDevice always runs on the one installed

stopDevice.description: Stops the device check, whatever happened

listFlows.description: Prints the end-to-end flows the changes since the base appended reach, one per line, without running them

runFlows.description: Runs the flows named after it on the started device check, printing `passed <flow>` or `failed <flow>: <where>` for each; with SHOTS_DIR set, saves each flow's last screen there

reviewBots.description: Review bots such as Greptile or CodeRabbit: their verdict and threads settle before auto-merge goes on

anyOf.description: This project doesn't use the module

login.description: The bot's GitHub login, with or without [bot], e.g. greptile-apps or coderabbitai

verdict.description: Regex whose first group is the bot's verdict, searched in the PR body and the bot's reviews and comments, latest first, e.g. greptile_confidence_score:(\d)

pass.description: Regex the verdict must match for the bot to pass, e.g. ^[45]$; without it any verdict passes

threads.description: findings: each open thread of the bot's is settled before auto-merge goes on; advisory: read, and fixed only when confirmed

bots.description: The review bots on the project's pull requests, by name

hygiene.description: Catalog tools the project climbs one rung at a time, a slice a night

anyOf.description: This project doesn't use the module

tools.description: Each catalog tool's rung in this project; a tool left out is off

foreman.description: How the foreman sets up worktrees, picks inspectors and pushes

setup.description: Runs in each new worktree before its temp starts, e.g. pnpm wt:setup

teardown.description: Runs in a merged worktree before factory clean removes it, e.g. to drop its databases; a list runs each in order

security.description: Globs, from the project root, of files whose change also gets the security inspector

migrations.description: Globs of schema files whose change needs a migration generated before factory push

areas.description: Codebase areas for the trust ledger, each a name and its globs from the project root; left out, the security, migrations and mobile native globs plus each top-level folder

migrationFiles.description: Globs of the generated migration files, numbered by their names' leading digits; factory push lets a schema change through with a new one numbered past the base's

generate.description: Generates the migration for a schema change, e.g. pnpm db:generate; factory push lets a schema change through when this writes nothing

pushCheck.description: A fast check factory push runs in the worktree before git push, refusing the branch when it fails, e.g. pnpm verify; left out, push runs none

schemaChanges.description: How far a branch that changes the migrations globs goes, read from the base: merge (the default) auto-merges like any PR, pr pushes with auto-merge off, park asks a person before pushing

schemaPush.description: A non-interactive command that pushes the schema to a non-production database, e.g. pnpm db:push; read from the base, factory schema-push runs it only on a machine with SCHEMA_PUSH=on

heavy.description: Commands factory calls counts on rows of their own, e.g. pnpm e2e:spec

requires.description: Tools the runner checks on the machine before it starts a shift: pnpm, docker (running), playwright (Chromium installed); left out, no check

gate.description: The gate: the checks a change passes before it merges

checks.description: The checks the gate runs on a change, in order: each one is a verdict

run.description: Shell command that runs the check in the change's checkout; the units `select` printed follow it as arguments

select.description: Shell command run in the change's checkout with the base commit as its argument, printing the units the change needs, one per line (spec files, say); printing none means the change needs no run

when.description: Globs of changed files that need this check, `!` excluding; any change past docs when left out

timeout.description: The machine config key whose minutes bound one run

tries.description: Runs a failing unit gets; one that fails and then passes is flaky

module.description: The module that supplies this check, such as mobile

when.description: Globs of changed files that need this check, `!` excluding; any change past docs when left out

docs.description: Globs of files that need no check, `!` excluding

status.description: Prefix of the commit status each check posts, as in signoff/web

merge.description: The merge step: how the queue lands what passed the gate

install.description: Installs dependencies in the merge queue's clone, and in the runner's checkout sync, whenever pnpm-lock.yaml changes

links.description: Files the queue's clone links from the main checkout, such as .env

needs.description: Commands that must succeed before the queue starts, such as docker info

fixups.description: What runs on each merge of main into a head before it is committed, in order

anyOf.description: Shell command run in the queue's clone while main merges into a head, the merge uncommitted and its conflicts in place, with FACTORY_MAIN and FACTORY_HEAD set; it mends what it can, and exits non-zero with why the head can't land

module.description: The module that supplies this fixup

removals.description: What the queue won't let a pull request remove without a label

files.description: Globs of files a pull request may delete or rename away only with the label

scripts.description: Whether removing a root package.json script needs the label too

holds.description: Under merge@3: shadow labels a PR its policy would hold would-hold and merges as merge@2; enforce refuses auto-merge on a held PR until a person approves it
